title: Fan died
body: The fan stopped spinning after four months and the unit just hums.

title: 太吵
body: 睡眠模式还是很吵，放卧室根本睡不着。

title: Filter light won't reset
body: The filter light stays on after a new filter and the app has no reset button.

title: Plastic smell
body: There is a strong plastic smell from the outlet for the first two weeks.

title: Pre-filter clogs
body: The pre-filter is covered in dust every week and washing it is a five minute job.

title: 风机异响
body: 用了半年风机开始咔咔响，晚上特别明显。

title: Third-party filters don't fit
body: Genuine filters cost a fortune and the cheap ones are a few millimetres too thick.

title: Too big
body: It is much bigger than the photos, it takes a third of the bedroom wall.

title: Good, noisy on turbo
body: Air feels cleaner, but on turbo it is too loud to watch TV.

title: 不值
body: 两千多的机器，效果跟几百块的差不多，不值。

title: Cracked housing
body: The housing cracked around the handle after a small knock.

title: Hot air outlet
body: The air coming out is warm and the top of the unit gets hot after an hour.

title: Quiet and effective
body: Barely audible on low and my allergies improved within a week.

title: 滤芯贵
body: 原厂滤芯一年要换四次，成本快赶上机器了，不值。

title: App drops connection
body: The app loses the purifier every few days and auto mode stops working.

title: Loud rattle
body: There is a rattle from the fan housing at high speed.

title: Filter fits badly
body: The filter sits loose in the housing and air leaks around the seal.

title: 噪音大
body: 高档位噪音像吹风机，客厅根本没法待。

title: Solid
body: Does the job in a small flat, the sleep mode is quiet enough.

title: Cloth pre-filter
body: The washable pre-filter is thin and tore at the seam in the second wash.

title: Died in a year
body: After a year the fan bearing failed and it squeals constantly.

title: 清洁麻烦
body: 外壳缝隙积灰擦不到，得拆开才能清。

title: Overpriced
body: It costs more than a branded unit with the same CADR and feels cheaper.

title: 太大
body: 机身太大了，小户型放着占地方。

title: Won't turn on
body: It worked for two weeks then would not power on at all.

title: Whistling
body: There is a high pitched whistle from the outlet at medium speed.

title: Bulky
body: The footprint is large and the cable is short, so it has to sit in the middle of the room.

title: 好用
body: 开着几乎听不见，过敏好多了，滤芯更换也简单。

title: Cheap buttons
body: The touch buttons stopped responding and the plastic coating peeled.

title: 电机烧了
body: 用了八个月电机烧了，焦味很重。

title: Warm exhaust
body: The exhaust makes the room warm, which is annoying in summer.

title: Dust on the grill
body: Dust collects on the outlet grill and is hard to wipe off.

title: App 连不上
body: App 老是掉线，自动模式就失效了。

title: Great value
body: Cheaper than the big brands and the air quality reading matches my meter.

title: Squealing fan
body: A loud squeal started after three months, worse at night.

title: Fine, filter cost
body: Works well but the replacement filters are expensive for what they are.

title: Loose seal
body: The filter seal does not sit flush, dust gets past it into the outlet.

title: 满意
body: 净化效果明显，噪音低，值这个价。
